name: PartsCounterQuoteBuilder
tagline: VIN-fitted parts quotes with branch stock, trade price tiers and one-click conversion to sales orders.
description: A complete parts counter quoting app for dealer parts departments in one PCF control: decode the VIN, find the parts that fit, see stock at every branch, price them for retail, trade, fleet, body shop or workshop accounts, check margin and send the quote – then convert accepted quotes to sales orders with stock reservation, transfer and supplier-order lines.
features: VIN validation and model/year decoding with manual fallback
Catalogue search with fitment filter and supersession
Stock chips per branch with transfer and order-in detection
Trade price tiers, manual price override and capped extra discount
Margin target with override, below-cost protection and deposits
Quote board with allowed moves and drag & drop
Quote-to-order conversion with PO control and stock reservation
Orders: ready to collect, awaiting stock, invoiced
Bulk send, extend validity, CSV export, undo
Power Fx outputs and OnCreate/OnSave/OnStatusChange/OnAction events
Demo mode with fictional catalogue and 36 quotes
